title: Execution policy: which harness, provider, model and effort run an invocation
description: Model routing is policy, not architecture (WC §18). Resolved once at dispatch and pinned on the invocation (ADR-0010). With configured=false no invocation receives a policy-selected execution and harness launch is refused; there is no built-in provider or model. Only environment variable NAMES appear here, never values.

containment.description: OS filesystem containment of harness runs (F2, Linux; ADR-0009 amendment). mode required (the default) refuses a launch whose sandbox cannot be established or fails its self-test; allow_weaker launches it labelled workdir_separation_only. writable adds existing directories every contained run may write (recorded on each run's label); a root that equals, contains or lies under what containment protects (the project's .aew, its git directories, the runs directory, /tmp, the Python environment, a masked secret) is refused at launch. hide masks further secret files or directories. trusted_git_drivers names the git filter, diff and merge drivers AEW's own git may run (an installed program agents cannot modify, such as git-lfs); every other configured driver, hook and fsmonitor is switched off, and a dispatch whose base assigns an untrusted filter is refused.
